data.name: The One Who Returned
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THE GAME

This is a story-driven action RPG set in a fantasy world. You play as a character who has lost their memory, beginning your journey in a seemingly peaceful forest with no knowledge of who you are or where you came from.

As you progress, you will uncover fragments of your past, explore the world, and face growing threats.

GAMEPLAY

The game focuses on exploration, combat, and questing:

  • Fight using melee and ranged weapons.

  • Explore a world filled with enemies, diverse locations, and challenges.

  • Complete main and side quests.

  • Acquire equipment through combat, rewards, and trading.

CHARACTER PROGRESSION

There is no fixed class system. You decide how you want to play:

  • Fight with a sword, use a bow, or change your playstyle at any time.

  • Develop your character by leveling up and spending stat points.

  • Customize your hero by changing and upgrading your equipment.

WORLD & EARLY ACCESS

The first available region is a forest area. The game world will expand during Early Access with:

  • New regions and environments.

  • New items and more diverse enemies.

  • The introduction of a magic system.

  • More main and side quests.

  • Additional gameplay mechanics.
